buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Purchase Preference (Centre) Indian suppliers of this item are not allowed to participate and/ or compete in procurement by some foreign governments. Bidders / products from such countries are not eligible / not allowed to participate in this bid in terms of clause 1 (d) of Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017 5. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase Preference linked with Local Content (PP-LC) Policy: The bid clause regarding “Preference to Make In India products” stands modified in this bid and shall be governed by the PPLC Policy No. FP-20013/2/2017-FP-PNG dated 17.11.2020 issued by MoP&NG as amended up to date. Accordingly, bidders with Local Content less than or equal to 20% will be treated as “Non Local Supplier”. The prescribed LC shall be applicable on the date of Bid opening. Sanctions on the bidders for false / wrong declaration or not fulfilling the Local Content requirement shall be as per the PPLC policy. Further following additional provisions are added in the certification and verification of local content

provision of the Preference to Make in India clause: i. In case of foreign bidder, certificate from the statutory auditor or cost auditor of their own office or subsidiary in India giving the percentage of local content is also acceptable. In case office or subsidiary in India does not exist or Indian office/subsidiary is not required to appoint statutory auditor or cost auditor, certificate from practicing cost accountant or practicing chartered accountant giving the percentage of local content is also acceptable. ii. Along with Each Invoice: The local content certificate (issued by statutory auditor on behalf of procuring company) shall be submitted along with each invoice raised. However, the % of local content may vary with each invoice while maintaining the overall % of local content for the total work/purchase of the pro-rata local content requirement. In case, it is not satisfied cumulatively in the invoices raised up to that stage, the supplier shall indicate how the local content requirement would be met in the subsequent stages. iii. The bidder shall submit an undertaking from the authorized signatory of bidder having the Power of Attorney along with the bid stating the bidder meets the mandatory minimum LC requirement and such undertaking shall become a part of the contract. 6. Purchase Preference (Centre) Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Micro and Small Enterprises whose credentials are validated online through Udyog Aadhaar/URC for that product/service category. If the bidder wants to avail the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. 7. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 8. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 9. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PART I – TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. INVITATION FOR BID Online bids are invited through the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal from eligible and competent sel lers for the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of air-conditioning units and associated materials , including buyback of existing air-conditioning units, at the premises of the Income Tax Department, Kozhik ode. The procurement shall be governed by the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), relevant pr oduct/category-specific Special Terms and Conditions (STC), bid-specific conditions published on GeM and a

pplicable Government of India procurement rules and instructions. Location of work: The work to be carried out under this contract at Income Tax Office Kozhikode under the Office of Principal Commissioner of Income Tax Kozhikode. 2. SCOPE OF WORK The scope of work shall include, but shall not be limited to, the following: 1. Supply of 1.0 TR, 5-Star inverter split air-conditioners – 7 Nos. 2. Supply of 1.5 TR, 5-Star inverter split air-conditioners – 6 Nos. 3. Supply of 4.0 TR, 3-Star inverter 4-way cassette air-conditioners – 2 Nos. 4. Supply of suitable normal and heavy-duty wall brackets. 5. Installation of all 13 split air-conditioners and 2 cassette air-conditioners. 6. Supply and installation of copper pipe kits for all 13 split air-conditioners. 7. Supply and installation of additional copper refrigerant piping, communication cables, drainage pipes and other accessories as required at site and as provided in the BOQ. 8. Complete installation, testing and commissioning of all equipment. 9. Providing all necessary fasteners, clamps, supports, insulation, sleeves, protective coverings and oth er accessories required for proper installation. 10. Demonstration of the operation of all units to the authorised representative of the Department. 11. Dismantling and removal of existing air-conditioning units included in the buyback schedule, after co mpletion of the prescribed buyback and disposal formalities. 12. Removal of installation debris and making good any damage caused to the premises during installati on or dismantling. The work shall be completed in all respects, with the equipment functioning satisfactorily and in accordance with the technical specifications, manufacturer's installation instructions and GeM contract. 3. BILL OF QUANTITIES (BOQ) The items and quantities proposed for procurement are as follows: Sl. No. Description Unit Quantity 1 1.0 TR, 5-Star Inverter Split AC Nos. 7 2 1.5 TR, 5-Star Inverter Split AC Nos. 6 3 4.0 TR, 3-Star Inverter 4-Way Cassette AC Nos. 2 4 Heavy-Duty Wall Bracket Nos. 2 5 Wall Bracket Nos. 13 6 Installation Charges – Split AC Nos. 13 7 Installation Charges – Cassette AC Nos. 2 8 Copper Pipe Kit – Split AC Sets 13 9 Additional Copper Refrigerant Pipe Metre 10 Communication Cable Metre Estimated quantit y to be entered in

11 Drainage Pipe Metre BOQ As per Annexu As specified in Ge 12 Buyback of Existing Air-Conditioners re-III M Note: a. Numerical estimated quantities shall be entered for additional copper refrigerant piping, communication cable and drainage pipe wherever required by the GeM BOQ. b. Bidders shall quote unit rates for these variable-quantity items. Actual payable quantities, where measure d on an actual-quantity basis, shall be verified and certified by the Department and shall remain within the BOQ/contractual provisions and applicable GeM rules. c. No additional quantity or item shall be undertaken or charged without prior written approval and complia nce with the contract. d. The requirement of two heavy-duty brackets and thirteen normal wall brackets shall be confirmed with re ference to the actual locations and equipment for which they are intended. 4. MANDATORY SITE INSPECTION 1. The bidder shall inspect the premises where the air-conditioners are to be installed before submissio n of the bid. 2. The site inspection is intended to enable bidders to assess actual installation conditions, including lo cations of indoor and outdoor units, distances between indoor and outdoor units, additional copper pipin g requirements, communication cabling, drainage arrangements, electrical connection points, accessibility and other site-specific requirements. 3. The bidder shall satisfy itself regarding the site conditions and the materials and labour required for s atisfactory completion of the work. 4. The bidder shall upload a duly signed Site Inspection Certificate in the format prescribed in Annexure -II along with the bid. 5. Failure to submit the required site inspection certificate may render the bid liable for rejection as non -responsive, subject to the conditions published in the GeM bid. 6. Site inspection shall be carried out at the bidder's own cost. No separate payment shall be made for the visit. 7. Site inspection shall be made available to all prospective bidders on equal terms. The bidder shall co ordinate with the designated Departmental contact person for access. 5. ELIGIBILITY AND DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED The bidder shall upload the following documents, wherever applicable and as required in the GeM bid: 1. Valid GST registration certificate. 2. PAN details of the bidder/proprietorship/firm/company. 3. Acceptance of the bid terms and conditions. 4. Model-wise technical compliance statement. 5. Manufacturer's product catalogue/datasheet for each model offered. 6. Pre bid meeting & Site inspection certificate 7. OEM authorisation/dealership/distributorship certificate, wherever required by the applicable GeM ca tegory or bid conditions. 8. Details of the authorised service centre or service-support arrangement for Kozhikode District.

9. Warranty undertaking and after-sales service details. 10. Any other document specifically required in the GeM bid. Documents already available and verifiable through the GeM seller profile need not be duplicated unless sp ecifically required in the bid. 6. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS AND COMPLIANCE 1. The air-conditioners offered shall strictly comply with the detailed technical specifications incorporat ed in Annexure-I of this bid. 2. The bidder shall quote the make, brand and exact model number of each air-conditioner offered. 3. The bidder shall submit the OEM's published technical datasheet/catalogue for each model. 4. The bidder shall submit a model-wise compliance statement indicating compliance or non-complianc e against every prescribed technical parameter. 5. The technical specifications shall be treated as minimum requirements. Any offered product failing t o meet a mandatory specification shall be liable for rejection. 6. The Department reserves the right to verify technical details from the OEM's official website, catalog ue or other authentic sources. 7. The supplied units shall be brand new, unused, genuine and of current production, and shall not be r efurbished, reconditioned or second-hand. 8. The make and model accepted during technical evaluation shall not be changed without prior written approval of the Department. 7. INSTALLATION AND ASSOCIATED MATERIALS 1. The successful bidder shall be responsible for complete installation, testing and commissioning of all air-conditioning units. 2. The bidder shall provide all materials necessary for proper installation, including copper refrigerant p ipes, insulation, communication cables, drainage pipes, brackets, fasteners, supports, clamps, protectiv e coverings and other accessories as applicable and as included in the BOQ. 3. Copper piping, communication cables and drainage pipes shall be of suitable quality, size and specifi cation, and shall be compatible with the equipment and the manufacturer's installation requirements. 4. All installation shall be carried out in accordance with the OEM's prescribed installation procedures a nd applicable electrical and safety standards. 5. Refrigerant piping shall be properly insulated, supported and protected. Refrigerant joints, vacuumin g, leak testing and refrigerant charging shall be carried out as prescribed by the OEM. 6. Drainage arrangements shall ensure proper discharge of condensate without leakage or damage to the building. 7. Electrical and communication connections shall be completed safely and neatly, using suitable cable s and protective arrangements as required. 8. The bidder shall ensure that installation does not damage the existing building structure, finishes, el ectrical installations or other services. 9. The bidder shall rectify, at its own cost, any damage caused to the premises due to negligence or im proper installation by its personnel. 10. Installation shall be considered complete only after successful testing and commissioning an d acceptance by the Department. 8. BUYBACK OF EXISTING AIR-CONDITIONERS 1. The Department proposes to offer the existing air-conditioning units installed at its premises for buyback in connection with the procurement of new air-conditioning units under this bid. The details of the existing u nits proposed for buyback shall be furnished in Annexure-III.

2. The bidder shall inspect the existing air-conditioning units during the compulsory site inspection and a ssess their physical condition, working status, completeness and approximate residual value before quoti ng the buyback price. 3. The bidder shall quote the total price for the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of all new air-conditioning units, and separately indicate the buyback value offered for the existing air-conditioning units in the Financial Bid. 4. The net financial bid amount shall be calculated by deducting the total buyback value offered for the e xisting air-conditioning units from the total quoted cost of the new air-conditioning units, including install ation and other applicable charges. The net amount so arrived at shall be considered for financial evaluat ion and determination of the lowest bidder (L1). 5. The buyback value shall be clearly indicated as a separate component in the Financial Bid and shall no t be adjusted against individual item rates or concealed in the quoted prices of new air-conditioning units . 6. The successful bidder shall dismantle and remove the existing units included in the buyback schedule, including indoor units, outdoor units, brackets, associated piping, wiring and other components, only to t he extent directed and authorised by the Department. 7. The cost of dismantling, labour, handling, packing, loading, transportation and removal of the old units shall be borne entirely by the successful bidder. No separate payment shall be admissible from the Depa rtment towards these activities. 8. The buyback value offered by the successful bidder shall be adjusted against the total contract value payable for the supply and installation of the new air-conditioning units. No separate payment or credit of the buyback amount to the Department's bank account shall be required, as the buyback value shall alre ady have been accounted for through deduction while arriving at the net contract value. 9. Removal of the existing units shall be undertaken only with the prior permission of the authorised offic er of the Department and shall be coordinated with the installation of the new units so as to minimise disr uption to office functioning. 10. The successful bidder shall be responsible for safe handling, transportation and lawful disposal/recycling of the old units and their components in accordance with applicable environmental law s, e-waste management requirements and other statutory provisions. 11. The bidder shall not remove or take possession of any old air-conditioning unit unless it is specifically included in the buyback schedule and authorised for release by the Department. The Department reserv es the right to verify the quantity and identity of the old units before handing them over. Any discrepanc y shall be resolved before removal. 12. The buyback arrangement shall not relieve the successful bidder of its obligation to supply, install, te st and commission all new air-conditioning units in accordance with the BOQ, technical specifications and GeM contract. 9. DELIVERY AND COMPLETION PERIOD 1. The successful bidder shall deliver all equipment and complete installation, testing and commissioni ng within 15 days from the date of issue/acceptance of the GeM contrac. 2. The bidder shall coordinate the delivery and installation schedule with the designated officer of the D epartment. 3. All equipment shall be delivered to the consignee address specified in the GeM contract. 4. The bidder shall not commence installation or dismantling without obtaining necessary instructions a nd access permission from the Department. 5. The entire work, including buyback removal obligations, shall be completed within the stipulated peri od unless otherwise permitted in writing by the Department in accordance with the contract. 10. INSPECTION, TESTING AND ACCEPTANCE 1. The Department or its authorised representative shall have the right to inspect the equipment and m aterials at the time of delivery and during installation. 2. Inspection at the time of delivery shall not relieve the bidder of responsibility for defects, non-confor

mity or deficiencies subsequently noticed. 3. The Department shall verify the make, model, capacity, quantity, condition and technical compliance of the supplied equipment. 4. The successful bidder shall demonstrate the operation of each unit after installation. 5. The bidder shall rectify any defects or deficiencies noticed during inspection, testing or commissionin g without additional cost. 6. Final acceptance shall be accorded only after satisfactory completion of installation, testing and com missioning and submission of required documents. 11. WARRANTY AND AFTER-SALES SERVICE 1. The equipment shall carry the warranty prescribed in the relevant GeM category/bid and the OEM's w arranty terms. The bidder shall clearly furnish the warranty period applicable to each component, inc luding compressor and other parts, as specified in Annexure-I and the GeM bid. 2. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects and defects arising from improper installation or wor kmanship attributable to the bidder. 3. During the warranty period, the bidder shall arrange repair or replacement of defective parts/equipm ent, including labour and visit charges, without additional cost to the Department, in accordance with the warranty and contract conditions. 4. The bidder shall ensure availability of an authorised service centre or OEM-authorised service-suppor t facility in Kozhikode District, Kerala. 5. If the bidder does not presently have such a facility, the successful bidder shall make the necessary a uthorised service-support arrangement before commencement of installation and furnish documenta ry evidence to the Department. 6. The bidder shall attend service complaints within 24 hours of registration and shall take necessary st eps for rectification within a reasonable period, depending on the nature of the defect and availability of parts. 7. Warranty obligations shall remain in force notwithstanding inspection, installation, commissioning or payment. 12. PRICE AND TAXES 1. The bidder shall quote its rates in the BOQ on the GeM portal and complete any separate buyback pri ce fields required by the GeM facility. 2. The quoted prices shall include all applicable costs, including equipment, packing, forwarding, transp ortation, loading, unloading, insurance, installation, labour, testing, commissioning, accessories and a pplicable taxes, as required by the BOQ and GeM price structure. 3. The buyback value shall be quoted separately in the manner prescribed by GeM. Its treatment in the evaluated/contract price shall follow the applicable GeM bid and buyback mechanism. 4. No additional payment shall be admissible for items or activities already included in the quoted rates or the scope of work. 5. Any variation in quantity shall be governed by the BOQ, the GeM contract and applicable GeM provisi ons. No extra item or quantity shall be undertaken or charged without prior written approval and com pliance with the contract. 13. PAYMENT 1. Payment shall be made through the GeM payment mechanism, subject to the applicable GeM GTC, c ontract terms and submission of the prescribed invoice and supporting documents. 2. Payment shall be processed after satisfactory delivery, installation, testing, commissioning and accep tance by the authorised representative of the Department, in accordance with the GeM contract. 3. Statutory deductions, including TDS and other applicable deductions, shall be made as per prevailing rules. 14. DELAY IN DELIVERY/INSTALLATION Delay in delivery or completion shall be dealt with in accordance with the liquidated damages and other pro visions of the applicable GeM GTC, STC and GeM contract. The Department reserves the right to take approp riate contractual action in case of failure to complete the work within the stipulated period, subject to applic able contract provisions. 15. EMD AND PERFORMANCE SECURITY

Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), exemption, Performance Security and other security requirements, if applica ble, shall be governed by the provisions and settings of the GeM bid and applicable Government of India ins tructions. No separate requirement inconsistent with the GeM bid or applicable policy shall be imposed. 16. REJECTION OF GOODS The Department reserves the right to reject any equipment or material which: 1. Does not conform to the technical specifications or approved make/model. 2. Is found damaged, defective, refurbished or used. 3. Is not supported by genuine OEM documentation, wherever required. 4. Does not meet the required capacity, performance or other mandatory parameters. 5. Is supplied in deviation from the accepted bid or GeM contract. Rejected equipment/material shall be replaced or rectified by the successful bidder at no additional cost wit hin the period stipulated by the Department and in accordance with the contract. 17. SAFETY AND RESPONSIBILITY 1. The bidder shall deploy technically qualified personnel for installation and dismantling. 2. The bidder shall ensure compliance with applicable safety requirements during transportation, handli ng, installation, testing and removal of old units. 3. The bidder shall be responsible for the conduct and safety of its personnel. 4. The bidder shall ensure that its personnel follow the security and entry procedures of the Department . 5. The bidder shall not cause obstruction to the normal functioning of the office and shall carry out work in coordination with the designated officer. 18. AUTHORISED SERVICE SUPPORT The successful bidder shall furnish the address, contact number and documentary proof of the authorised se rvice centre/service-support facility in Kozhikode District before commencement of installation. The bidder s hall ensure continued after-sales and warranty support for the entire warranty period. 19. TERMINATION AND OTHER REMEDIES In the event of material breach, failure to supply conforming equipment, failure to complete installation, fail ure to honour warranty obligations or failure to complete buyback obligations, the Department may initiate appropriate action in accordance with the GeM GTC, STC and contract, including cancellation/termination, re covery of applicable damages and other remedies available under the contract and law. 20. CLARIFICATIONS AND CORRIGENDA 1. Prospective bidders shall refer to the GeM portal for all bid-related clarifications, corrigenda and ame ndments. 2. Any clarification issued by the Department through the GeM portal shall form part of the bid docume nts. 3. Bidders shall be responsible for monitoring the GeM portal until the bid submission deadline. 4. No verbal clarification shall modify the published bid conditions. 21. PRECEDENCE OF TERMS In case of any inconsistency, the applicable GeM GTC, relevant category-specific STC, GeM bid conditions an d contract provisions shall prevail in accordance with the GeM framework and applicable Government procu rement rules. These additional conditions shall be read subject to the above provisions. 22. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS Submission of a bid shall imply that the bidder has read and understood the bid documents and agrees to c omply with the applicable GeM GTC, STC, bid-specific conditions, technical specifications and terms of the c ontract.
